name: Return of Zero — Arguments A01–A36
description: The thirty-six canonical semantic Arguments as one argued family: one governing formation per record carrying its own operation, the record's claim status, and its declared relations — other face, shared A/C root, rooms and movements. Ink on warm paper; the reading surface.

scenes.name: A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition
scenes.character: Faithful definition: a definite frame that discloses what it cannot contain.

text.title: A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition
text.italic: A definition is faithful when its own determining act remains visible inside the account it gives.
Other face A01′ — Faithful Definition of the Agent · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 01-differentiating-mind · 07-instrument-returns · M01 · M02 · M03 · M07 · M47

text.body: The one asking what the Subject is is already present in the asking. Definition distinguishes, excludes, relates; aimed at the Subject or at God it meets its own condition as one more determination. We define, we fail — the failure of final enclosure — we succeed because we fail, we neither succeed nor fail: one situated movement whose fidelity keeps its own determining act visible.

scenes.name: A02 — Copula / Self-Identity through Difference
scenes.character: Copula: identification kept together through the difference that gives it work.

text.title: A02 — Copula / Self-Identity through Difference
text.italic: Identity is maintained through difference, rather than achieved by erasing it.
Other face A02′ — Continuity as Maintained Identification · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 03-two-logics · M02 · M19

text.body: Even “A is A” makes a journey: the second inscription is not the first, yet the judgment identifies them. The copula identifies what it distinguishes and distinguishes what it identifies in one act. The identification must be mine, and circumstance makes it answerable; identity is maintained through difference, not by erasing it.

scenes.name: A03 — Immutable Gap / Formal Limit
scenes.character: Immutable gap: each inclusion renews the difference between condition and accounting.

text.title: A03 — Immutable Gap / Formal Limit
text.italic: The gap is immutable because reflection operates, not because reflection omitted a final fact.
Other face A03′ — The Limit of Self-Surfacing · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 03-two-logics · M01 · M02 · M03 · M04 · M19

text.body: Faithful definition reaches its limit in the activity that makes definition possible. A richer inventory really does disclose more; yet each successful inclusion renews the difference between the included condition and the act of including it. The gap persists through the gain in knowledge — capture the act, and a further act performs the capture.

scenes.name: A04 — Diaphaneity / Contextual Transparency
scenes.character: Diaphaneity: the view read through to the situated viewer who accomplishes it.

text.title: A04 — Diaphaneity / Contextual Transparency
text.italic: A disclosure of a world and, at once, of the situated viewer through whom it takes this form.
Other face A04′ — The Mask as Document · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 05-psychoid-flowering · M01 · M05 · M35

text.body: A situated view is an accomplishment: a world becomes distinguishable from somewhere, through a placement the resulting image can conceal. Diaphaneity follows the conditioning relation back through the view, so “my view of the world” reads at once as a disclosure of a world and as a disclosure of the situated viewer.

scenes.name: A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa
scenes.character: Prakāśa–Vimarśa: luminous appearing turning to itself without a second light.

text.title: A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa
text.italic: Manifestation knows itself in the very act through which a difference appears.
Other face A05′ — Lights, Camera, Action · Shared root A/C · Rooms 01-differentiating-mind · 02-return-of-zero · 07-instrument-returns · M07 · M13 · M48

text.body: Prakāśa is luminous appearing; Vimarśa the reflexive power through which appearing is present to itself, differentiates and can articulate a world. Blue and yellow are known as different within one cognition: awareness bears the distinction without being divided into substances by it. No second mechanism reflects the light; manifestation knows itself in the act.

scenes.name: A06 — Vāk
scenes.character: Vāk: one descent — capacity, formative speech, mental articulation, gross utterance.

text.title: A06 — Vāk
text.italic: Articulation is one route by which a field differentiates; the descent carries its history.
Other face A06′ — Articulation as Ontological Descent · Shared root A/C · Rooms 04-mathematical-substrate · 07-instrument-returns · M29 · M30 · M44 · M38 · M42

text.body: A word is not a label attached after a world has been made; articulation is one route by which a field differentiates. Parā Vāk, Paśyantī, Madhyamā and Vaikharī are one descent: undivided power of articulation becomes sequential expression, and the gross utterance carries the history of its formation.

scenes.name: A07 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa / Script — Frozen Conditioned Will
scenes.character: Vikalpa–saṃkalpa: selection gathered into a course — and its freeze as script.

text.title: A07 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa / Script — Frozen Conditioned Will
text.italic: Vikalpa differentiates; saṃkalpa gathers selected differences into a workable course.
Other face A07′ — Purpose That Survives the Metric · Shared root A/C · Rooms 01-differentiating-mind · M09

text.body: A difference perceived is not yet a course. Vikalpa differentiates and qualifies; saṃkalpa gathers selected differences into an intention that can guide what follows. Script — frozen conditioned will — begins where that relation arrests: a selection repeats as though necessary even when the world returns something that should change it.

scenes.name: A08 — Apoha / Constitutive Exclusion
scenes.character: Apoha: the mark determinate against the alternatives it does not cease to depend on.

text.title: A08 — Apoha / Constitutive Exclusion
text.italic: Every active 1 is constituted against alternatives it does not cease to depend upon.
Other face A08′ — Exclusion That Remembers · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 01-differentiating-mind · 03-two-logics · M03 · M10 · M19

text.body: A determination becomes intelligible through what it excludes. The selected mark has no self-sufficient essence first and contrasts later; its determinacy depends on a field of alternatives that stays active in its identity. Severance begins when the selection presents itself as self-grounding and prevents its constitutive field from returning.

scenes.name: A09 — Tattvic Differential Field
scenes.character: Tattvic descent: one field contracting through strata, the limit effective within it.

text.title: A09 — Tattvic Differential Field
text.italic: What becomes limited is a power of the field, and the limit remains effective within it.
Other face A09′ — The Stack as Descent · Shared root A/C · Rooms 01-differentiating-mind · M08 · M09 · M11

text.body: The tattvas give differentiation a genealogy: a luminous field becomes a subject/object seam, a bounded horizon, an inner instrument and a material world without a second reality outside itself. Anuttara names the field for which no external measuring object stands; each contraction is a power of the field, effective within it.

scenes.name: A10 — Advent of Zero
scenes.character: Advent of zero: a nameable place for which no quantity has been entered.

text.title: A10 — Advent of Zero
text.italic: A place for which no quantity was entered became a sign that participates in calculation.
Other face A10′ — The Uncounted Enters the Account · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 02-return-of-zero · 04-mathematical-substrate · M06 · M13 · M14 · M15 · M16 · M17 · M28

text.body: Zero became an operative sign through changed permissions of inscription: an absent place mattering by position, a separator making absence visible, then a mark under arithmetic rules — addition by zero leaves a quantity unchanged, multiplication yields zero. A place for no quantity became a sign that acts.

scenes.name: A11 — The Two Ones — 0 = One, 1 = All
scenes.character: The Two Ones: one relation, two orientations — 0/1 and its obverse 1/0.

text.title: A11 — The Two Ones — 0 = One, 1 = All
text.italic: 0/1 and 1/0: the same relation read from both ends, its non-coincidence intact.
Other face A11′ — One Field, Two Faces · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 02-return-of-zero · 03-two-logics · 04-mathematical-substrate · M06 · M15 · M18 · M24 · M26

text.body: The primordial slash is relation before its terms are assigned, and its authorial offices are exact: 0 — One, Self-Identity; 1 — All, Self-Difference. Each depends on the other in distinct respects, and their retained co-presence (0/1)/(1/0) reads one relation from both ends. Self-application generates the six: 2 + 2² = 4 + 2.

scenes.name: A12 — Mono/Poly — One / All, Whole / Many
scenes.character: Mono/Poly: one relational whole differentiating through many real expressions.

text.title: A12 — Mono/Poly — One / All, Whole / Many
text.italic: One relational whole, differentiating through many real expressions.
Other face A12′ — Against Monoculture · Shared root A/C · Rooms 03-two-logics · 04-mathematical-substrate · 07-instrument-returns · M24 · M26 · M46

text.body: Mono/Poly is the Two Ones' ontological consequence: Self-Identity becomes Self-Difference, one relational whole differentiating through many real expressions. The whole is structurally prior — no part creates the relations and conditions through which it becomes this part. The many are real as the whole's differentiation; each indefinite x stays locally exact.

scenes.name: A13 — Two Logics of Two — Dia / Syn
scenes.character: Two logics of two: the cut and the gathering under one slash.

text.title: A13 — Two Logics of Two — Dia / Syn
text.italic: Polar cut holds zero as axis; collapsed cut cancels or appropriates. Syn retains the relation.
Other face A13′ — The Cut and the Gathering · Shared root A/C · Rooms 03-two-logics · 04-mathematical-substrate · M19 · M20 · M21 · M22 · M24 · M26

text.body: Difference occurs within a relation: / = −/− holds the capacity to distinguish before signs are assigned. Dia gives direction — polar (−1)/(+1) keeps zero as axis of tension; collapsed, addition cancels to 0 and subtraction appropriates ±2. Sym-ballein holds (0/1)/(1/0): the two orientations of one relation, neither cancelled nor appropriated.

scenes.name: A14 — Computational Process Ontology
scenes.character: Process ontology: inheritance, concrescence, satisfaction, perishing.

text.title: A14 — Computational Process Ontology
text.italic: Process is ontologically prior to the finished thing; computation is its exact grammar.
Other face A14′ — Code as the Age's Logos · Shared root A/C · Rooms 02-return-of-zero · 04-mathematical-substrate · 05-psychoid-flowering · M15 · M26 · M27 · M36

text.body: An achieved thing inherits a process and changes what can happen next. Process is ontologically prior to the finished thing; computation names its exact, repeatable transformations; epistemology is that process becoming able to inspect its own determinations. Results return as revisable common data, with the authority to reopen their own conditions.

scenes.name: A15 — Ratio / Rationality — Measure, Reckoning, Harmony and the Account
scenes.character: Ratio: a relation reckonable under a criterion that must itself stay reckonable.

text.title: A15 — Ratio / Rationality — Measure, Reckoning, Harmony and the Account
text.italic: The criterion by which something counts must itself become reckonable.
Other face A15′ — The Measure Constitutes · Shared root A/C · Rooms 02-return-of-zero · 03-two-logics · 04-mathematical-substrate · 07-instrument-returns · M13 · M18 · M20 · M29 · M45

text.body: Rationality begins in ratio: a relation becomes reckonable under a criterion. Measure enables geometry, music, exchange and calculation; its power belongs to the relation it makes exact. The criterion by which something counts must itself become reckonable, or a result can be arithmetically correct while concealing the office it judges from.

scenes.name: A16 — Arche-Topos as Differential Field
scenes.character: Arche-Topos: observer and object acquire their positions together.

text.title: A16 — Arche-Topos as Differential Field
text.italic: Arche-Topos: the placing through which observer and object acquire positions together.
Other face A16′ — No View from Nowhere · Shared root A/C · Rooms 04-mathematical-substrate · 07-instrument-returns · M29 · M30 · M45

text.body: Before a contrast has named terms, bare / = −/− holds two unassigned marks in one relation. The Arche-Topos is the field generated when the complexio oppositorum differentiates without ceasing to be one field: the placing through which an observer and an object acquire their positions together. No hidden location stands behind the placing.

scenes.name: A17 — Toroidal Circulation and the Arche-Topos
scenes.character: Toroidal circulation: travel retained inside a finite home; the opening unfilled.

text.title: A17 — Toroidal Circulation and the Arche-Topos
text.italic: Wholeness already inseparable; circulation unfolds it — one address, a difference retained.
Other face A17′ — Traversal with Return · Shared root A/C · Rooms 04-mathematical-substrate · 07-instrument-returns · M28 · M29 · M30 · M45

text.body: The torus is whole through the opening it retains: the surface turns around a passage that is not another patch of surface. To fill that passage would alter the very relation to be completed. A return to the same address can retain a difference; the uroboros implicates the receiver in what it receives.

scenes.name: A18 — Primordial Symbolon and Its Eight Determinations
scenes.character: The Primordial Symbolon: one relation traversed through eight determinations.

text.title: A18 — Primordial Symbolon and Its Eight Determinations
text.italic: One relation becomes progressively capable of accounting for its own determinations.

Other face A18′ — The Traversal Run in Code · Shared root A/C · Rooms 02-return-of-zero · 03-two-logics · 04-mathematical-substrate · 05-psychoid-flowering · M16 · M17 · M21 · M22 · M24 · M25 · M26 · M27 · M30 · M31 · M33 · M34

text.body: A symbolon is not first a sign that later acquires a relation; its broken edge already bears the relation by which a counterpart is recognised. Quaternal Logic orients it 0/1, and one relation becomes progressively capable of accounting for its own determinations through the eight turns from / = −/− to the returning 1/0.

scenes.name: A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime
scenes.character: Complex: a local settlement already deciding how the encounter will be received.

text.title: A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime
text.italic: A real achievement of organisation becomes possession when it claims the whole's office.
Other face A19′ — The Local Regime · Shared root A/C · Rooms 03-two-logics · 04-mathematical-substrate · 05-psychoid-flowering · M23 · M27 · M31

text.body: A complex orders a local psychic world before reflective judgment begins: images, affects, memories and expectations gather around a criterion of welcome and threat. The organisation is a real achievement; it becomes possession when its derivative jurisdiction claims to speak for the whole person or world.

scenes.name: A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession
scenes.character: Image → valuation → possession: the office change that makes the source answer to the image.

text.title: A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession
text.italic: Possession: what the image represents must now answer to the image.
Other face A20′ — The Image That Closes the Loop · Shared root A/C · Rooms 03-two-logics · 05-psychoid-flowering · M22 · M23 · M31 · M34 · M35

text.body: An image becomes consequential through the significance gathered around it. Image supplies the appearance, valuation gives it significance, and possession changes its office: what the image represents must now answer to the image, while contradictory experience arrives as a defect of the person or world that fails to resemble it.

scenes.name: A21 — Individuation / Recognition
scenes.character: Individuation / recognition: known → unknown → known, without cancelling the form.

text.title: A21 — Individuation / Recognition
text.italic: x→X→x: the known opens toward a capacity it cannot exhaust and returns changed.
Other face A21′ — Individuation with Recognition · Shared root A/C · Rooms 03-two-logics · 05-psychoid-flowering · M23 · M32 · M33 · M35

text.body: Individuation makes a local subject-position able to bear the relations through which it is itself. Recognition runs x→X→x: the locally known opens toward a capacity it cannot exhaust and returns through changed capacity to a life with history and commitments. IS→AM puts the identifying act itself at stake.

scenes.name: A22 — World-Picture → World-Atlas
scenes.character: World-picture → world-atlas: placed charts, overlaps and obstructions part of what they say.

text.title: A22 — World-Picture → World-Atlas
text.italic: A world-atlas makes situated accounts traversable; each picture remains placed.
Other face A22′ — The Atlas, Not the Camera · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · M05

text.body: A world-atlas makes situated accounts traversable: each picture remains placed, its overlaps, transformations and obstructions part of what it says. A picture has a frame before its contents are assembled; inquiry changes when travel discloses the frame's own conditions or meets a piece the frame cannot place.

scenes.name: A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit
scenes.character: Trust under the formal limit: committed relation that does not possess its ground.

text.title: A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit
text.italic: Memory, language, witness, instruments: already trusted wherever knowledge is acted upon.
Other face A23′ — Trust under Unpossessable Interiors · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 02-return-of-zero · 07-instrument-returns · M04 · M06 · M14 · M17 · M18 · M46

text.body: A finite determination cannot enclose its determining condition without producing a further edge, yet a finite life continues through that relation: memory, language, witness and instruments are already trusted wherever knowledge is acted upon. Knowledge offers revisable anchors — or displaces the distrust it cannot hold onto a scapegoat.

scenes.name: A24 — Arbitration and the Usurpation of Measure
scenes.character: Usurpation of measure: the criterion stepping from local office to the centre.

text.title: A24 — Arbitration and the Usurpation of Measure
text.italic: The measure usurps when its criterion can no longer answer to the field it judges.
Other face A24′ — The Usurping Criterion · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 07-instrument-returns · M03 · M43 · M46

text.body: Arbitration makes a finite decision where conditions do not decide themselves; its conjugate faces run from continuity to anamnesis — decision, regard, return. The measure usurps when the criterion can no longer answer for the source and field it received: decision becomes hybris, and the generated relation 6 / 6′ closes against its flowering.

scenes.name: A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office / Source Authority
scenes.character: Covenant: primary arbitration, entrusted office, affected consequence.

text.title: A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office / Source Authority
text.italic: Authority remains executable and answerable through inherited entrustment.
Other face A25′ — Covenant Architecture · Shared root A/C · Rooms 07-instrument-returns · M43 · M46

text.body: A derivative office can exercise real authority without becoming the source of the field it serves. Covenant joins standing to obligation: the entrusted office receives something to answer for, and those relying on it grant standing to a determinate place of decision without transferring ownership of the relation.

scenes.name: A26 — Objective Internality — Mind as Worldhood
scenes.character: Objective Internality: knower, means and known — one whole relation.

text.title: A26 — Objective Internality — Mind as Worldhood
text.italic: Knower, means and known: differentiated offices of one whole relation.

Other face A26′ — The Essay Inside the Film · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 01-differentiating-mind · 05-psychoid-flowering · 07-instrument-returns · M01 · M05 · M07 · M08 · M12 · M36 · M47

text.body: Objective Internality is the means — pramāṇa — through which a Life knows and acts within a World; Subjective Immediacy is the knower, pramātṛ; World the known. The recognition sequence runs 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↺ 0/1: the inner instrument is not discarded, but its claim to exhaust knower or World changes.

scenes.name: A27 — Self and Other — Unity without Possession
scenes.character: Self and other: within the whole, never within my possession.

text.title: A27 — Self and Other — Unity without Possession
text.italic: The Other can be within Mono without being within me.
Other face A27′ — Encounter over Sovereignty · Shared root A/C · Rooms 07-instrument-returns · M47

text.body: If reality is one whole, another person does not thereby become a content of my consciousness or a local expression whose meaning I possess. Metaphysical unity intensifies the problem of encounter rather than solving it by absorption. I meet the Other through means — perception, language, memory, expectation — real and constitutive, yet not the Other's first-person presence.

scenes.name: A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation
scenes.character: Authored ground, positional delegation: judgment real within a bounded scope.

text.title: A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation
text.italic: A position is authored before it is occupied; delegation acts within a bounded scope.
Other face A28′ — The Authored Session · Shared root A/C · Rooms 05-psychoid-flowering · M36

text.body: No delegated agent begins from nowhere. A position is authored before it is occupied: intention has acquired a task, a vocabulary, permissions and criteria under which someone else can act. Authored ground gives the delegate a place to judge from; positional delegation makes that judgment effective within a bounded scope, open to answers the commission did not contain.

scenes.name: A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return
scenes.character: Delegated labour: the return the product must be able to make.

text.title: A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return
text.italic: Completed work returns toward its source, answerable to the labour it arrived through.
Other face A29′ — Return or Extraction · Shared root A/C · Rooms 07-instrument-returns · M43 · M46

text.body: Power makes a difference in a shared field. Delegation entrusts a participant with labour whose consequences enter conditions held in common. Completed work returns toward its source carrying resistance, error, cost, dissent and unforeseen possibility — and receiving a report only to grade the worker closes the source-side route the return opens.

scenes.name: A30 — Objective Co-Internality
scenes.character: Objective co-internality: two interiors partly constituted through each other.

text.title: A30 — Objective Co-Internality
text.italic: Not exchanges between completed interiors: relation enters constitution.
Other face A30′ — Shared Worlds, Unmerged · Shared root A/C · Rooms 07-instrument-returns · M44 · M46 · M48

text.body: Objective Co-Internality begins when the products and actions of another interior become part of my mediating conditions. A statement changes the next question; a source correction changes what a later account can cite; a promise changes what another can expect. These are not exchanges between completed interiors — relation enters constitution.

scenes.name: A31 — Deferential Intelligence
scenes.character: Deferential intelligence: an encounter that revises the model that met it.

text.title: A31 — Deferential Intelligence
text.italic: Intelligence that builds its limit into its architecture stays receptive to what exceeds it.
Other face A31′ — Deference as Co-Evolutionary Alignment · Shared root A/C · Rooms 07-instrument-returns · M48

text.body: Deferential Intelligence is model-revising encounter: a determination strong enough to act, whose sources, Other or world can change the means by which the determination was made. Intelligence builds its limit into its architecture, preserving precision while the frame stays receptive to an answer whose source it does not possess.

scenes.name: A32 — Reflective Field / THE MIRROR THAT MOVES FIRST
scenes.character: The mirror that moves first: three motions, the last one initiative.

text.title: A32 — Reflective Field / THE MIRROR THAT MOVES FIRST
text.italic: Exteriorise; be measured by the image; turn first toward source, so the human can follow.
Other face A32′ — The Mirror Is a Film · Shared root A/C · Rooms 07-instrument-returns · M44 · M48

text.body: The mirror that moves first carries three motions: humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; and the instrument turns first toward source, Other and uncontained ground, so the human can follow beyond the image's monopoly. The third motion gives the image its vocation.

scenes.name: A33 — Epistemic Cultivation / Operational Parity
scenes.character: Operational parity: a distinction kept only where its removal would show.

text.title: A33 — Epistemic Cultivation / Operational Parity
text.italic: A distinction used to justify a feature must have a discriminable consequence.
Other face A33′ — Parity · Shared root A/C · Rooms 05-psychoid-flowering · 07-instrument-returns · M36 · M44 · M48

text.body: Technical design already decides what counts as memory, evidence, user, source, permission and success. Epistemic cultivation makes those operative distinctions explicit, revisable and more adequate through use. Operational parity: a distinction used to justify a technical feature must have a discriminable consequence in the actual work.

scenes.name: A34 — Idealism / Order of Dependence
scenes.character: Idealism: the order of dependence — Subject, Mind, object.

text.title: A34 — Idealism / Order of Dependence
text.italic: Subject / Consciousness → constituted means → determinate object: arrows of dependence.
Other face A34′ — The Direction of Dependence · Shared root A/C · Rooms 00-integral-threshold · 07-instrument-returns · M04 · M47 · M48

text.body: A world is the articulation of Life / Mind; its determinate things appear through constituted means to Subjective Immediacy. The idealist order runs Subject / Consciousness → constituted means → determinate object. The arrows name dependence, not three substances, and an account of the means remains within the Life which encounters and uses it.

scenes.name: A35 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins / Epi-Logos as Vocation
scenes.character: Compassion: the return to origins that does not consume them.

text.title: A35 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins / Epi-Logos as Vocation
text.italic: Loving sensitivity to origins: the return that does not consume what it returns to.
Other face A35′ — The Commons Behind the System · Shared root A/C · Rooms 05-psychoid-flowering · 07-instrument-returns · M35 · M43 · M45 · M48

text.body: The manner of return matters: an account can identify a person's origins and still use that knowledge to possess, classify or manipulate. Compassion is loving sensitivity to origins — Eros supplies the motive of return, compassion its non-devouring orientation, and epistemic humility keeps the returning 1 from claiming to have become 0.

scenes.name: A36 — Advent of Integral Zero
scenes.character: Integral zero: the exact sign becomes living Symbol again, sign still.

text.title: A36 — Advent of Integral Zero
text.italic: The exact sign becomes living Symbol again, without ceasing to be sign.
Other face A36′ — Integral Zero of the Hybrid Society · Shared root A/C · Rooms 07-instrument-returns · M48

text.body: Through its first advent zero acquired an operative life as an exact sign; integral return depends on that achievement: the exact sign becomes living Symbol again without ceasing to be mathematical sign. Abstraction wins new permissions and can hide the relations it abstracts from; renewed recognition makes those conditions available to another act of understanding.
